ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel mottling concentrated along the trailing edges of both lobes. Dense white cluster at the left lateral tip. Extensive light-grey and white 'splatter' pattern covering the upper 40% of the right lobe. The central fluke and peduncle insertion area consist of contiguous low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression at the center, approximately 110 degrees, with a sharp vertex at the junction of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Notable macro-level notch/indentation located on the right lobe approximately 30% inward from the tip. Frequent jagged peaks visible along the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the lateral tips, transitioning to convex curves on the outer margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white pixel clusters (scars) detected against the dark background on the lower central and left lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned light-grey linear streaks visible on the dark pigmented surface of the left lobe's lower quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent semi-circular notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe suggesting prior trauma. Orange-brown biological attachments (likely cyamids or kelp) visible at the far left tip and on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'flecked' white pigmentation pattern localized specifically to the interior upper section of the right lobe, distinct from the solid white tip of the left lobe.
